title: Rectangle toolkit
description:
Write two functions and use them from `main`:

- `int area(int width, int height)` returns width × height
- `int perimeter(int width, int height)` returns the distance around the rectangle

`main` reads a width and a height and prints:

```
Area: 12
Perimeter: 14
```

(for the input `3 4`).

Keep `main` short: it should only read the input, call your functions and print.
hints: A function can take several parameters, separated by commas: `int area(int width, int height)`.
The perimeter is two widths plus two heights: `2 * (width + height)`.
rules: Write a function `int area(int width, int height)`.
Write a function `int perimeter(int width, int height)`.
